# Synthetic Runtime fixture compatibility variant

This is a **test-only recipe**, not a shared-worldview migration, a scientific
correction, an original-study reproduction, or permission to bypass semantic
admission. The original frozen fixture and its failed evidence remain untouched.
Full Reasoner admission and genuine Runtime Jobs remain acceptance gates.

## Five explicit fixture choices (contract v2)

| Source | Synthetic variant | Limit of interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Decision process `within` an Agent | Explicit process dependency `of` that Agent | Avoids cross-family observational containment; not a domain-science correction to Decision. |
| Structural SocialConnection with no orientation | Explicit structural bond | Chooses symmetry for this synthetic fixture only; no claim about all real social connections. |
| Functional StreamConnection with no orientation | Explicit functional directed relationship | Selects the independent orientation axis; no flow/data algorithm changes. |
| Configuration applicability preceding a parent expression with `of` | Parent/emergence expression first, applicability second | Matches the existing native parser's explicit configuration form; does not hide invalid inherency. |
| Legacy ODO0.1.1 release locator | Actual captured `http://integratedmodelling.org/odo/0.2.0` version IRI | Pins the unchanged bundled bytes (`496bc663...bcf2a57`); no download, replacement, publication claim or relabeling of legacy bytes. |

The native source regressions keep all four original declaration negatives rejected and check
the explicit variants using the existing parser/adapter/declaration registry.
No validator, diagnostic severity, platform code or scientific algorithm is edited.

## Byte-preservation contract (v2, unchanged default)

`contract.json` pins the entire243-file/3,832,217-byte frozen project tree, all
four edited preimages/postimages, and exactly five replacement spans. The tool
copies into a **new directory outside Git workspaces**, changes only those spans,
and checks both the original and copied bytes. The other239 files stay identical.
It refuses unknown inputs, links/junctions, overlapping paths, existing outputs,
ambiguous substitutions and model/oracle drift. I/O failures preserve any partial
output for diagnosis; there is no automatic rollback, overwrite or retry.

The four `python.fixture` manifest/namespace hashes remain those of the earlier
controlled reference. The oracle is unchanged: `100 + 93/4 = 123.25` metres in
all20 cells, with no missing cells. **Preserved model bytes do not prove numerical
execution.** Unused TEST-control declarations are retained verbatim, never invoked
by this preparation tool. No third-party raster or worldview source tree is
redistributed in this PR; the operator supplies the already-approved frozen input.

From a checkout with the frozen `projects` directory available:

```text
python python-client/tools/prepare_runtime_fixture.py FROZEN_PROJECTS NEW_PRIVATE_PROJECTS
```

The parent of the destination must already exist. Protect private directories using
platform permissions. No credentials are read or issued, no service or Job starts,
and no network call is made. The receipt says
`PREPARED_NOT_SEMANTICALLY_ADMITTED` and `semantic_admission: UNKNOWN` intentionally.
Exit3 means failure/UNKNOWN; retain the original and any partial output.

## Opt-in explicit-bearer execution variant (v3)

The subsequent native/source-service audit reproduced a separate v2 blocker:
the original constant Elevation model parses, but authoring and executable source
validation reject its primary with `MODEL_OUTPUT_UNRESOLVED`. The production
source-publication and selected-model preparation gates reject it too. A complete
client request alone cannot conceal that source rejection. These failures remain
retained in PR120/121; no validator is relaxed and no original model is overwritten.

`execution-contract-v3.json` pins the exact unchanged v2 contract and opts into a
**new synthetic execution contract**. In a fresh copy only, it changes:

```text
model geography:Elevation in m set to [100 + 23.25];
```

to:

```text
model geography:Elevation of (earth:Terrestrial earth:Region) in m set to [100 + 23.25];
```

The matching request definition is explicitly recorded in the new contract. This
is not labelled as passing the original unqualified query or reproducing a study.
The generated model identity also differs; old Job/model/handle identities must not
be reused or relabelled. Original/v1/v2 sources, receipts and failures stay intact.

The numerical expression, independent123.25-metre/20-cell reference, manifest and
other fixture namespaces remain unchanged. The original model's byte hash remains
the input preimage; the derived model gets its own separate postimage hash, never
a claim of byte identity. The tool verifies that exact numerical expression in
both preimage and postimage before writing. There are5 changed files/6 pinned
replacement spans and238 identical files relative to the frozen original tree.
The v3 output-tree SHA-256 is
`0c83bf62d2ae1764e9225a7152f6808b30b9d2a132c9b92106d71c951cea7995`.

V2 remains the default API/CLI behavior. Opt in explicitly:

```text
python python-client/tools/prepare_runtime_fixture.py FROZEN_PROJECTS NEW_PRIVATE_V3_PROJECTS --explicit-bearer
```

The same fresh-path/no-links/no-overwrite/source-preservation rules apply. The
receipt remains `PREPARED_NOT_SEMANTICALLY_ADMITTED` with semantic admission UNKNOWN,
records the new execution contract and states `original_acceptance_replaced:false`.
No source is published, no expression evaluated and no services or Jobs launched.

Current v3 software checks:46 focused tests,100% unexcluded preparation-tool line/
branch coverage,2,087 offline tests,seven coverage gates,lint and wheel/sdist build
pass. The sdist contains exact v2/v3 contracts, tool and native validator; all32 wheel
source modules match and development fixtures/tools stay out of the core wheel.
Native full-inventory declaration/core-identity validation passes26 ontologies,
two strategies and three namespaces. None is numerical or notification acceptance.

The native in-process source/preparation comparison also accepts the exploratory
explicit-bearer model without evaluating it;37 related native regression cases pass
under PR120. Five compiler diagnostics from the separate private OWL subset remain
preserved. A real-service v3 source/admission preflight must pass before any fresh
bounded execution. V3 operational admission, numerical readback and automatic-hook
activity delivery remain unverified at this checkpoint; no merge or reproduction
claim follows from the preparation/parse passes.

### Subsequent served admission and bounded execution evidence

The corrected real-service v3 preflight passed: the exact derived source was
retrieved with an admission receipt, and both native validation modes returned
source-complete results without notifications. It created no sessions, contexts or
Jobs. All14 recorded JVM identities were independently absent afterward and3,905
backend input hashes matched. The earlier preflight failure at the obsolete model
identity remains retained; no failed directory was reused.

Bounded run13 then retrieved both region and Elevation Job results and verified all
20 cells equal123.25 metres. It nevertheless remains **FAIL**: persisting the received
activity evidence raised TypeError on a nested frozen payload. This does not count
as completed notification acceptance. All owned receiver/queue/context/session/list/
publisher-socket/HTTP cleanup steps passed, all14 recorded JVM identities were
independently absent and3,905 backend hashes matched. Two confirmed submission
receipts take precedence over the legacy outer report's zero observation counter.

The original failed writer source was preserved with its launch hash before the
private harness correction. Twenty-eight offline cases reproduce the writer failure,
verify strict recursive JSON projection without opaque-value stringification,
preserve separate primary/cleanup failures, and confirm scientific request/readback
calls are unchanged. Received hints are now flushed/fsynced individually before
aggregate evidence output. No draft is merged on the strength of run13's partial success.

Fresh bounded run14 also remains **FAIL**. Source preflight passed, the region Job
returned a result, but the Elevation Job failed before readback/activity persistence
with `JobFailedError`. The corrected evidence writer was not reached. Both explicit
submissions are confirmed. All owned cleanup steps passed; all14 recorded JVM
identities were independently absent,3,905 backend hashes and all fixture launch
hashes matched, and no matching owned visible windows remained.

The Reasoner exception maps to `AcceptedSemanticRuntime.invoke:406`, the fail-closed
guard for an accepted-generation change during evaluation of `resolving`. The
authority-bootstrap failure preceding it also occurs in run13, so that bootstrap
failure alone is not a demonstrated explanation for the differing Job outcomes.
The publication trigger and full cross-service failure chain are still under
investigation using offline/read-only diagnostics. No guard is weakened, candidate
publication frozen, service dependency changed or failed scientific Job replayed.

## Validation boundaries

1. **Software checks:**33 Python cases pass with100% unexcluded tool line/branch
   coverage. The22 selected native source cases pass, including four original/
   variant declaration pairs and captured core identity verification. Dedicated CI
   retains those negatives and compiles the validator.
2. **Prepared bytes:** v2 copies the real frozen tree with4 edited files and239
   unchanged files; model/oracle hashes are preserved. V1's3-file/240-unchanged
   declaration-only copy and receipt remain retained. Neither is admission.
3. **Offline native validation:** `ValidateRuntimeFixture.java` reuses native
   dependency-ordered parsing, LanguageAdapter, semantic visitors, strategy/model
   validation and the whole-worldview declaration registry. It writes a new result
   outside the input tree. It never turns errors into warnings or filters failed
   declarations. The initial comparison found four distinct diagnostics (seven
   occurrences across document and registry checks); the variant passes all26
   ontologies,2 strategies and3 namespaces with zero error diagnostics. Both owned
   validator JVMs exited. The operational v1 run then correctly rejected the legacy
   ODO import identity against the captured0.2.0 catalog; it submitted no contexts
   or scientific Jobs. V2 additionally checks the actual bundled core hash/version
   and the complete26/2/3 inventory. It rejects empty/partial fixtures. The stronger
   original/v1/v2 comparison confirms original FAIL/FAIL, v1 PASS/FAIL and v2
   PASS/PASS for declaration/capture identity respectively. All three owned JVMs
   exited; none of this is operational admission.
4. **Operational acceptance:** v2 live attempt5 passed the all-services-operational,
   semantic-search and two ordinary-user readiness gates. It created two contexts
   and obtained two observation Job submission receipts. This is **not successful
   scientific execution**: Resolver logged region `NO_MODEL` and elevation `FAILED`;
   no numerical readback or genuine activity-delivery acceptance was recorded.
   Resources also logged a Jackson model-transport serialization failure, whose
   exact offending field remains unproven. A final publisher-socket cleanup
   assertion masked the original exception. Both context releases and session
   release returned true and the context list was empty, but publisher socket
   absence failed. All14 recorded JVM identities are independently absent, with no
   corresponding visible windows. Failed live evidence/receipts remain retained;
   no automatic mutation replay occurred. Actual queue/socket cleanup, numerical
   execution and notification delivery remain acceptance gates; no merge.

Compile the validator against source-matched Resources service classes and that
service's declared runtime dependency closure; do not mix historical snapshot
JARs by filename. Use a private JVM home/temp directory and invoke:

```text
java -cp SOURCE_MATCHED_CLASSES_AND_DECLARED_DEPENDENCIES ValidateRuntimeFixture PROJECTS NEW_RESULT_JSON
```

It validates all served ontology/strategy/`python.fixture` namespaces, reports
whole-worldview declaration errors, and returns0/3 for offline PASS/FAIL. Output
also states `runtime_operational: UNKNOWN`; it starts no services or scientific Jobs.
The complete243-file inventory additionally retains the staging project unchanged;
its real workspace/model admission is checked by the later operational fixture,
not claimed by this focused offline helper.

PR117 and Python notification PR108 remain draft until their actual acceptance
gates pass. Neither these fixtures nor byte hashes authorize a deployment change,
package publication, producer outreach, taxonomy inference or scientific result.
